_comment: OPERATOR-OWNED MCP manifest (REVISE-2 gate B9). The probe fails the boot when
the generated mcp.json or the live tools/list diverges from THIS file in either
direction: a missing server, an EXTRA server, a destructive tool the manifest
does not expect (new upstream capability -> must be reviewed and denied here
first), or an expected destructive tool that is absent (stale manifest, or the
wrong endpoint answered). destructive lists were enumerated from the LIVE hosted
endpoints on 2026-07-31; the pattern the probe scans live tools with is
built-in tools that must appear in JCODE_TOOLS_DENY, including its `mcp`
management tool (a cycle must not be able to reconfigure its own tool surface).
